selection_rule.criterion: first feasible checked plan; deterministic priority; no learned selector, seed lookup or duration predictor
selection_rule.fallback_scope: preflight geometric rejection only; execution/perception failure stops
selection_rule.physical_coverage: 8130 auto selects orient-first. Sequential-end is separately forced for physical comparison. Actual automatic fallback after an orient-first rejection is unit-tested, not physically triggered by this scene.

comparison.timing_boundary: first motion to final visual acceptance, including intervening planning, perception and diagnostic costs; excludes startup/proposal preparation
comparison.sampling_limit: one forced run per strategy on the final controller, plus one auto run; not a statistical speed estimate

development_fixes: Unique current measured cuboid surface support for failed held fragments; keep ambiguous/outlier obstacles.

Reconcile still-held payload on the fresh post-open image before the empty first arm retreats.
